scope: Owned DSH: three native work thumbnails/navigation and Photo-source return to a Deck parent; previous Vector-parent recovery retained.
checks: project overview displayed decoded derived thumbnails for Photo, Deck and Vector sources
physical overview selection opened the actual Photo, Deck and Vector sources
return retained exact Deck source, native App, selected object and zoom
native keyboard Undo after return restored the manual move made before entering Photo
limits: The source-return tests cover a Vector parent and a Deck parent entering an actual bound source; a normal switch between independent works may reopen the other App.
Crash recovery may reopen a fresh App and explicitly disclose that in-memory history is lost; it does not promise recovery of input never checkpointed.
